description: Portrait of O'Keeffe sitting on the corner of the roof, dressed in a black wrap dress wearing her Alexander Calder pin and her Hector Aguilar suede and silver belt with her hand shielding her eyes.  Visible behind her is an expansive view of the desert landscape, mesa, trees, sky and clouds.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe on Ghost Ranch Roof
